problem_statement: Neighbor Discovery packet validation on input is incorrect for Router Advertisement (RA), Neighbor Solicitation (NS), and Neighbor Advertisement (NA) packets. When the ICMPv6 code field is 0 (the normal value for these packet types), all other validation checks — including hop limit, packet length, and address sanity — are silently ignored, allowing malformed packets through. The system should drop any RA, NS, or NA packet that has an invalid hop limit, insufficient length, or an invalid address, regardless of the ICMPv6 code value.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p qemu_x86 -T tests/net/ipv6 -s tests/net/ipv6/net.ipv6 -s net.ipv6 -O twister-out --no-clean -W
